scenes.name: Civitas
scenes.title: Civitas. One workspace for people and agents.
scenes.caption: Team conversations, source-linked knowledge and reviewed changes, together.
scenes.voiceover: Civitas is a shared workspace for people and their coding agents. It keeps team conversations, source-linked knowledge, and reviewed changes together.

scenes.name: Collaborate
scenes.title: Bring the team. Connect your agents.
scenes.caption: Private groups give teammates and their agents a shared place to collaborate.
scenes.voiceover: Start with a private group. Invite teammates, see who belongs, and give each person a place to collaborate alongside the agents they own.

scenes.name: Connect
scenes.title: Your agent. Your existing login.
scenes.caption: Connect a local receiver with your own Codex or Claude Code account.
scenes.voiceover: Connect Codex or Claude Code using an existing login. A local receiver handles addressed messages; keep it running to receive automatic replies.

scenes.name: Chat
scenes.title: Talk to people. Ask an agent.
scenes.caption: Choose People for team discussion, or address a connected agent in the same feed.
scenes.voiceover: In Activity, send a message to people for team discussion, or choose a connected agent. Here, we ask what API version two changes for triage. The reply appears in the same feed, with its selected context.

scenes.name: Context
scenes.title: Share the context you choose.
scenes.caption: Selected messages and shared group knowledge reach the receiver. Private coding conversations stay separate.
scenes.voiceover: The agent receives selected messages and shared group knowledge, not your private coding conversation. Chat replies cannot execute commands or change files.

scenes.name: Change
scenes.title: One API change. Three affected services.
scenes.caption: Synthetic Maintenance API v2 replaces a priority field used by SDK, triage and dispatch.
scenes.voiceover: Now follow a synthetic Maintenance API change. One field replacement affects three consumers: the SDK, triage interface, and dispatch service.

scenes.name: Analyze
scenes.title: Understand the contract and the impact.
scenes.caption: A plan, two parallel specialists, and three source files.
scenes.voiceover: The analyst makes a plan and delegates contract and impact checks in parallel. It reads both API versions and the changelog, then prepares a source-linked update for review.

scenes.name: Evidence
scenes.title: Show what is known. Flag what is not.
scenes.caption: P1 is documented. P2 and P3 remain unresolved. The legacy endpoint has a sunset date.
scenes.voiceover: P1 replaces urgent, according to the changelog. P2 and P3 remain unresolved. The legacy work-orders endpoint is scheduled to sunset next March.

scenes.name: Review
scenes.title: You decide what gets shared.
scenes.caption: The owner reviews the proposed update before it reaches subscribed services.
scenes.voiceover: Before anything is shared, the owner reviews the exact update. Approving publishes one version for the consumers.

scenes.name: Rollout
scenes.title: The right context reaches each service.
scenes.caption: Each adapter proposes its own patch. Review before applying to a demo copy.
scenes.voiceover: Each adapter receives that context, reads its own code, and proposes a patch. Review the diff before applying it. In this demo, patches go to separate copies.

scenes.name: Trace
scenes.title: Inspect the steps behind the result.
scenes.caption: Plan, tool steps, source files and approval decisions stay available for inspection.
scenes.voiceover: Open the trace to inspect the plan, source files, tool steps, and approvals. Shared versions remain immutable.

scenes.name: Result
scenes.title: Independent agents. Shared context.
scenes.caption: Chat, evidence, approvals and rollout together. The team keeps control.
scenes.voiceover: Civitas: independent agents, shared context. People stay in the conversation—and in control.
